The 2025–26 Israeli Premier League, also known as Ligat TOTO Winner[2] for sponsorship reasons, is the 27th season since the introduction of the Israeli Premier League in 1999 and the 84th season of top-tier football in Israel. Due to the risk of missile strikes stemming from the 2026 Iran war, the league was suspended between 28 February and 4 April 2026.

Teams

[edit]

The league consists of fourteen teams; twelve sides from the previous season and two promoted teams from the 2024–25 Liga Leumit Hapoel Petah Tikva[3] and Hapoel Tel Aviv.[4] Both teams returned to the top flight after a single season. They replaced the 2024–25 Israeli Premier League bottom two teams, Hapoel Hadera[5] and Maccabi Petah Tikva[6] who were relegated to the 2025–26 Liga Leumit.
